name: The Eye of Paleth
summary: Fitzsimmons asks you to recover The Eye of Paleth from the sunken Intrepid. Bring the cursed gem to Glorin Steelbrow in Menethil Harbor, where the dwarven priest can seek a way to purge its blight.

sections.title: A Blighted Relic
sections.body: The locked strongbox aboard the Intrepid holds a blackened orb that pulses beneath the waters of Baradin Bay. It is The Eye of Paleth, warped from sacred light into a source of suffering. Its corruption is bound to the restless spirits and doom that claimed the sailors of the Third Fleet.

sections.title: Seeking the Priesthood
sections.body: Glorin Steelbrow examines the relic in Menethil Harbor. The dwarven priest of the Holy Light is stunned that such a sacred device belonged to the Third Fleet. He recognizes its unnatural taint and begins preparing rites to undo its dark influence.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?
faq.answer: The Eye of Paleth is an ancient, powerful sacred gem, normally tied to holy energies. The specimen aboard the sunken Third Fleet vessel Intrepid has become twisted and cursed, radiating dark magic.

aliases: where do i find the eye
faq.answer: You recover the Eye from a locked strongbox in the flooded wreck of the Intrepid, just off the coast of the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why does Glorin Steelbrow care about the artifact?
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarven priest stationed in Menethil Harbor. His knowledge of the Holy Light lets him recognize ancient relics and begin rites to break sinister curses.

faq.q: How does Fitzsimmons know about the Eye?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons survived the tragedy of the Third Fleet and remains haunted by it. Taking refuge in Menethil's tavern, he knew of the dark relic hidden in the wreckage, which tormented his fallen crewmates.

The Eye's corruption is tied to the supernatural deaths and restless undead haunting the wrecked ships of the Third Fleet. It absorbed dark energies during or after the catastrophe that sent the fleet to the ocean floor.

faq.q: What happens after giving the Eye to Glorin?
aliases: what to do with the eye
faq.answer: Glorin examines the cursed gem and sees it cannot remain blighted. He directs you to cleanse the relic of its corrupting influence.

angles.text: As a priest, the defilement of a sacred artifact like The Eye of Paleth makes this investigation matter to your faith in the Holy Light.
As a dwarf, you share a dedication to reclaiming lost relics off the shores of Khaz Modan, with Ironforge clergy like Glorin Steelbrow to aid you.
As an Alliance member, you know the Third Fleet's destruction left Menethil Harbor vulnerable. Recovering its remnants can bring closure to lost comrades.
